title: My tickets
loginDescription: Sign in to find all your passes, gifted tickets and secure access QR codes.
offlineBanner: Offline mode: Your access passes remain scannable at the entrance
emptyMyDescription: You don't have any tickets for yourself at the moment. Explore events to book your spot!
emptyGiftedDescription: You haven't bought a ticket for a friend yet. When you choose "Gift to a friend", your purchased tickets and their links will appear here.
emptyHistoryDescription: Your used, archived or refunded tickets will appear here.
claimModalDescription: A friend gifted you a spot for an event? Enter the token received or paste the full link to add the pass directly to your account.
toastKeepPostponed: Ticket confirmed for the new postponed date!
toastScanned: Ticket scanned and validated at the entrance! Enjoy the event 🎉
